steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded', '1'); const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); })()

steps.name: analyze-top-probe
steps.eval: (() => { const samples = window.__flyProbe || []; const angleBetween = (a, b) => { let dot = a.x*b.x + a.y*b.y + a.z*b.z + a.w*b.w; if (dot < 0) dot = -dot; dot = Math.min(1, dot); return 2 * Math.acos(dot); }; const deltas = []; for (let i = 1; i < samples.length; i++) deltas.push(angleBetween(samples[i-1], samples[i])); const avg = deltas.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / (deltas.length || 1); const max = Math.max(0, ...deltas); const lastStep = deltas[deltas.length - 1] || 0; const cam = window.__three.camera; const fwd = cam.getWorldDirection(new (Object.getPrototypeOf(cam.position).constructor)()); window.__probeResult = { sampleCount: samples.length, deltaCount: deltas.length, deltasDeg: deltas.map(d => +(d * 180 / Math.PI).toFixed(3)), avgStepRad: avg, maxStepRad: max, lastStepRad: lastStep, ratio: avg > 0 ? max / avg : 0, finalForward: { x: fwd.x, y: fwd.y, z: fwd.z } }; })()

steps.name: assert-no-terminal-spike
steps.eval: (() => { const r = window.__probeResult; if (r.deltaCount < 5) throw new Error('too few samples to judge smoothness: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); if (!(r.maxStepRad < r.avgStepRad * 2 + 1e-4)) throw new Error('terminal spike detected: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); if (!(r.finalForward.y < -0.999)) throw new Error('final view is not straight down: ' + JSON.stringify(r.finalForward)); })()

steps.name: analyze-home-probe
steps.eval: (() => { const samples = window.__flyProbe || []; const angleBetween = (a, b) => { let dot = a.x*b.x + a.y*b.y + a.z*b.z + a.w*b.w; if (dot < 0) dot = -dot; dot = Math.min(1, dot); return 2 * Math.acos(dot); }; const deltas = []; for (let i = 1; i < samples.length; i++) deltas.push(angleBetween(samples[i-1], samples[i])); const avg = deltas.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / (deltas.length || 1); const max = Math.max(0, ...deltas); window.__probeResult2 = { sampleCount: samples.length, deltaCount: deltas.length, avgStepRad: avg, maxStepRad: max, ratio: avg > 0 ? max / avg : 0 }; })()

steps.name: assert-home-no-terminal-spike
steps.eval: (() => { const r = window.__probeResult2; if (r.deltaCount < 5) throw new Error('too few samples to judge smoothness: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); if (!(r.maxStepRad < r.avgStepRad * 2 + 1e-4)) throw new Error('terminal spike detected on home view: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); })()
